go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Event

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type":       "string",
      "goJSONTags": ["omitempty"]
    },
    "created": {
      "type":       "string",
      "format":     "date-time",
      "goType":     "time.Time",
      "goImports":  ["time"],
      "goJSONTags": ["format:RFC3339Nano"]
    }
  },
  "required": ["created"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/eventpkg

go 1.26

require ()
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestEvent_FieldTypes(t *testing.T) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(Event{})
	createdField, ok := rt.FieldByName("Created")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Event has no Created field")
	}
	if createdField.Type != reflect.TypeOf(time.Time{}) {
		t.Errorf("Created type = %v, want time.Time", createdField.Type)
	}
	wantTag := `json:"created,format:RFC3339Nano"`
	if string(createdField.Tag) != wantTag {
		t.Errorf("Created tag = %q, want %q", string(createdField.Tag), wantTag)
	}

	idField, ok := rt.FieldByName("Id")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Event has no Id field")
	}
	wantIDTag := `json:"id,omitempty"`
	if string(idField.Tag) != wantIDTag {
		t.Errorf("Id tag = %q, want %q", string(idField.Tag), wantIDTag)
	}
}

func TestEvent_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"created":"2026-04-26T15:00:00Z","id":"abc"}`)
	var e Event
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &e); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if e.Id == nil || *e.Id != "abc" {
		t.Errorf("Id = %v, want pointer to \"abc\"", e.Id)
	}
	if e.Created.Year() != 2026 {
		t.Errorf("Created.Year = %d, want 2026", e.Created.Year())
	}
}
